Kalos Starter Set

Released November 8, 2013 · 39 cards

Expanded

Kalos Starter Set is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on November 8, 2013. It has 39 cards. It includes 33 Pokémon, 6 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

11 illustrators worked on Kalos Starter Set. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (22), Akira Komayama (2), Kagemaru Himeno (2), Kouki Saitou (2), Masakazu Fukuda (2), Mitsuhiro Arita (2), Naoki Saito (2), Shin Nagasawa (2).
